33:1: O Prophet! Fear Allah and do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites. Surely Allah is Knowing, Wise.
33:2: Follow what is revealed to you from your Rabb; surely Allah is Aware of what you do.
33:3: Put your trust in Allah, and Allah is sufficient as a Trustee.
33:4: Allah did not place two hearts inside any man. He did not make your wives from whom you practice zihar your mothers. Nor did He make your adopted children your sons. This is your word that you speak with your mouths. Allah speaks the truth, and He guides to the way.
33:5: Call them by attributing them to their fathers; this is more just in the sight of Allah. If you do not know their fathers, then they are your brothers in religion and your mawlas. And there is no sin upon you in that which you made a mistake, but (there is in) what your hearts deliberately intended; and Allah is Most Forgiving, Most Merciful.
33:6: The Prophet is closer to the believers than their own souls, and his wives are their mothers. And relatives are closer to one another in the Book of Allah than the other believers and the emigrants (muhajirun), except that you do good to your friends. This is written in the Book.
33:7: And when We took their covenant from the prophets; from you, from Noah, from Abraham, from Moses, and from Jesus, the son of Mary; and We took from them a solemn covenant.
33:8: So that He may question the truthful about their truthfulness; and He has prepared a painful punishment for the disbelievers.
33:9: O you who believe! Remember the favor of Allah upon you, when armies came against you and We sent upon them a wind and armies that you did not see; and Allah is the Seer of what you do.
33:10: When they came upon you from above you and from below you, when eyes shifted in fear, hearts reached the throats, and you were harboring thoughts about Allah.
33:11: There the believers were tested and shaken with a violent shaking.
33:12: And when the hypocrites and those in whose hearts is a disease were saying: 'Allah and His Messenger promised us nothing but a delusion.'
33:13: And when a faction of them said: 'O people of Yathrib! There is no place for you to stand, so return immediately.' And a group of them were asking permission of the Prophet, saying: 'Our houses are exposed (unprotected).' Whereas they were not exposed. They only wanted to flee.
33:14: If they had been entered upon from all sides, and then fitnah had been demanded from them, they would have given in to it at once, and they would not have remained in it except for a little while.
33:15: And indeed, they had pledged a covenant to Allah before that they would not turn their backs; and the covenant of Allah will be questioned.
33:16: Say: 'If you flee from death or being killed, fleeing will never benefit you, and then you will be granted enjoyment only for a little while.'
33:17: Say: 'If Allah intends evil for you, or intends mercy for you, who can protect you from Allah?' And they will not find for themselves besides Allah any protector (wali) or any helper.
33:18: Surely Allah knows those among you who hold others back, and those who say to their brothers: 'Come to us!' And they do not come to the battle except a little.
33:19: They are stingy towards you. When fear comes, you see them looking at you, their eyes rolling like one fainting from death. But when the fear is gone, they sting you with sharp tongues, being greedy toward the good. Those have not believed, so Allah has rendered their deeds void; and that is easy for Allah.
33:20: They think that the factions have not departed. And if the factions should come, they would wish that they were out in the desert among the Bedouins, inquiring about your news. And if they were among you, they would not fight except a little.
33:21: Indeed, there has been for you—for whoever hopes in Allah and the Last Day and remembers Allah much—an excellent example in the Messenger of Allah.
33:22: When the believers saw the factions, they said: 'This is what Allah and His Messenger promised us.' And Allah and His Messenger spoke the truth.
33:23: Among the believers are men who remained true to the covenant they made with Allah. Some of them fulfilled their vow, and some are waiting.
33:24: So that Allah may reward the truthful for their truthfulness, and punish the hypocrites if He wills, or accept their repentance.
33:25: Allah drove back those who disbelieved in their rage; they attained no good. Allah spared the believers from fighting. Allah is Strong, al-Aziz.
33:26: And He brought down from their fortresses those who assisted them among the People of the Book and cast terror into their hearts; a group you were killing, and a group you were taking captive.
33:27: And He made you inherit their land, their homes, their wealth, and a land upon which you had never set foot. Allah is Capable of all things.
33:28: O Prophet! Say to your wives: 'If you desire the life of this world and its adornment, come, I will provide for you and release you with a graceful release.'
33:29: And if you desire Allah, His Messenger, and the home of the Hereafter, then surely Allah has prepared for the doers of good among you a great reward.
33:30: O wives of the Prophet! Whoever of you commits a clear indecency, the punishment will be doubled for her twofold; and that is easy for Allah.
33:31: And whoever of you is obedient to Allah and His Messenger and performs righteous deeds, We will grant her reward to her twice, and We have prepared for her an honorable provision.
33:32: O wives of the Prophet! You are not like any other of the women. If you fear Allah, do not be soft in speech lest he in whose heart is a disease should lust, and speak appropriate words.
33:33: Remain in your homes, and do not display yourselves as in the display of the former Jahiliyyah; establish salah, give zakat, and obey Allah and His Messenger. Allah only intends to remove impurity from you, O people of the household, and to purify you with a thorough purification.
33:34: And remember what is recited in your houses of the verses of Allah and wisdom. Surely Allah is al-Latif, the All-Aware.
33:35: Surely Muslim men and Muslim women, believing men and believing women, obedient men and obedient women, truthful men and truthful women, patient men and patient women, humble men and humble women, charity-giving men and charity-giving women, fasting men and fasting women, men who guard their chastity and women who guard, men who remember Allah much and women who remember—Allah has prepared for them forgiveness and a great reward.
33:36: When Allah and His Messenger have decreed a matter, there is no choice for a believing man or a believing woman in their own affair. And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger has certainly strayed into clear error.
33:37: And when you were saying to the one whom Allah favored and you also favored, 'Keep your wife with you and fear Allah,' and you were concealing within yourself what Allah was to disclose, and you feared the people; whereas Allah is more worthy that you fear Him. Then, when Zayd had fulfilled his need of her, We married her to you so that there should not be any difficulty for the believers concerning the wives of their adopted sons when they have severed their ties with them. And the command of Allah has been accomplished.
33:38: There is no difficulty for the Prophet in that which Allah has made obligatory for him. It is the Sunnah of Allah concerning those who passed away before.
33:39: Those are they who convey what Allah has sent, who fear Allah and fear no one except Allah; and Allah is sufficient as a Reckoner.
33:40: Muhammad is not the father of any of your men, but he is the Messenger of Allah and the last of the prophets; and Allah is Knower of all things.
33:41: O you who believe, remember Allah with much remembrance.
33:42: And glorify Him morning and evening.
33:43: It is He who bestows mercy upon you and His angels seek forgiveness for you to bring you out from darkness into light; and He is most merciful to the believers.
33:44: Their greeting on the day they meet Him is 'Salam', and He has prepared for them a generous reward.
33:45: O Prophet, We have sent you as a witness and a bringer of glad tidings and a warner.
33:46: And as an inviter to Allah by His permission, and as an illuminating lamp.
33:47: Give glad tidings to the believers that there is a great bounty for them from Allah.
33:48: Do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites, pay no attention to their harassment, and put your trust in Allah. And Allah is sufficient as a Trustee.
33:49: O you who believe, when you marry believing women, then divorce them before you touch them, there is no waiting period (iddah) for you to count against them.
33:50: O Prophet, surely We have made lawful to you your wives to whom you have given their dowries, and those whom your right hand possesses from the female captives whom Allah has granted you as spoils of war, and the daughters of your paternal uncle, and the daughters of your paternal aunts, and the daughters of your maternal uncle, and the daughters of your maternal aunts who emigrated with you, and a believing woman if she offers herself to the Prophet, in case the Prophet wishes to marry her, exclusively for you apart from the believers. We certainly know what We have made obligatory upon them concerning their wives and those whom their right hands possess, so that there may be no difficulty upon you. And Allah is Most Forgiving, Most Merciful.
33:51: You may defer whom you will of them, and take to yourself whom you will. And if you desire any of those whom you had set aside, there is no blame on you. That is more suitable that their eyes may be comforted, that they may not grieve, and that all of them may be pleased with what you have given them. Allah knows what is in your hearts. Allah is Knower, Forbearing.
33:52: Women are not lawful to you after this, nor is it lawful for you to exchange them for other wives even if their beauty should amaze you, except what your right hand possesses; and Allah is Watcher over all things.
33:53: O you who believe! Do not enter the houses of the Prophet without observing its time, unless permission is given to you for a meal. But enter when you are invited. When you have eaten the meal, disperse and do not indulge in conversation. For that indeed hurts the Prophet, and he feels shy before you. But Allah does not feel shy of the truth. And when you ask something from them (his wives), ask it from behind a screen. That is purer for your hearts and their hearts. And it is not permissible for you to hurt the Messenger of Allah, nor to marry his wives after him ever. Truly, that is an enormity in the sight of Allah.
33:54: Whether you disclose a thing or conceal it, surely Allah is Knower of all things.
33:55: There is no blame upon them concerning their fathers, their sons, their brothers, their brothers' sons, their sisters' sons, their women, and those whom their right hands possess. Beware of Allah; surely Allah is Witness over all things.
33:56: Surely Allah and His angels send salat upon the Prophet. O you who believe! You also send salat upon him and greet him with full submission.
33:57: Surely those who annoy Allah and His Messenger, Allah has cursed them in this world and the Hereafter, and has prepared for them a humiliating punishment.
33:58: And those who harm believing men and believing women for what they have not earned, they certainly have burdened themselves with a slander and a manifest sin.
33:59: O Prophet! Tell your wives, your daughters, and the women of the believers to draw their outer garments over themselves. That is more suitable that they will be recognized and not be harmed. Allah is Most Forgiving, Most Merciful.
33:60: By oath, if the hypocrites, those in whose hearts is a disease, and those who spread false rumors in the city do not desist, We will certainly incite you against them.
33:61: Accursed, wherever they are found, they will be seized and killed with a complete killing.
33:62: This is the Sunnah of Allah concerning those who passed away before, and you will never find any alteration in the Sunnah of Allah.
33:63: People ask you about the Hour of Resurrection. Say: Its knowledge is only with Allah. What do you know, perhaps the Hour is near.
33:64: Surely Allah has cursed the disbelievers and has prepared for them a blazing fire.
33:65: They will abide therein forever; they can find neither a protector nor a helper.
33:66: The day their faces are turned about in the Fire, they will say: Would that we had obeyed Allah and obeyed the Messenger.
33:67: And they said: Our Rabb, we obeyed our leaders and our elders, but they led us astray from the path.
33:68: Our Rabb, give them double of the punishment and curse them with a great curse.
33:69: O you who believe, do not be like those who harmed Moses. Indeed Allah cleared him of what they said, and he was distinguished in the sight of Allah.
33:70: O you who believe, fear Allah and speak a straight word.
33:71: He will make your deeds righteous for you and forgive you your sins. Whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger has indeed attained a great success.
33:72: Surely We offered the trust to the heavens, the earth, and the mountains, but they shrank from bearing it and were afraid of it, and man bore it. Surely he is very unjust and very ignorant.
33:73: That Allah may punish the hypocrite men and the hypocrite women, and the polytheist men and the polytheist women, and that Allah may accept the repentance of the believing men and the believing women; and Allah is Most Forgiving, Most Merciful.
